Eligibility Criteria
Eligibility was based on the ezPoints balance at the time of the April 26, 2024, snapshot, not the user’s $ezETH balance. The minimum qualification for eligibility was
360 ezPoints per wallet
.
Wallets holding >500k ezPoints
: 50% unlocked at TGE, 50% linear vesting over 3 months.
Wallets holding ≤500k ezPoints
: Fully unlocked at TGE.
Sybil wallets
were identified and excluded.
Additional allocation
: 0.1% of the total supply was allocated to the Milady Maker and SchizoPosters communities.
